SCHEDULES
SCHEDULE 1 Section 3

EXEMPTED SUBSTANCES
Controlled drugs

1 Controlled drugs (within the meaning of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971).
Commencement Information
I67 Sch. 1 para. 1 in force at 26.5.2016 by S.I. 2016/553, reg. 2
Medicinal products

2 Medicinal products.
In this paragraph “medicinal product” has the same meaning as in the
Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (S.I. 2012/1916) (see regulation 2 of those
Regulations).
Commencement Information
I68 Sch. 1 para. 2 in force at 26.5.2016 by S.I. 2016/553, reg. 2
Alcohol

3 Alcohol or alcoholic products.
In this paragraph—
“alcohol” means ethyl alcohol, and
“alcoholic product” means any product which—
(a) contains alcohol, and
(b) does not contain any psychoactive substance.
Commencement Information
I69 Sch. 1 para. 3 in force at 26.5.2016 by S.I. 2016/553, reg. 2
Nicotine and tobacco products
